thread:
harper (Design): Quick sync after the review the gaussian smoothing default looks "too clean" and hides short-duration spikes. multiple CX reports say they missed sub-30s blips that mattered. we should expose a preserve-mode rather than changing the global default.

raj (PM): +1. Prefer opt-in per-panel or a user pref. idea: a 'local-peak-preserve' algorithm that keeps short local maxima while still dampening noise. can we make it metric-aware?

noa (VizEng): I prototyped a local-peak-preserve algorithm: sliding window + prominence check + adaptive threshold (median absolute deviation). config example: 
```
peak_mode: local_peak_preserve
window: 11
adaptive_threshold: true
prominence_factor: 2.5
marker: preserved_peak_dot
```
On latency traces it keeps 5-10s spikes, on error rates it ignores single-sample noise.

toni (A11y): Accessibility points: preserved peaks must be keyboard-focusable and expose an aria-label with value and timestamp (e.g. "peak +42% at 14:03 UTC"). also don't rely on color alone: add patterned marker or shape for colorblind palettes. current orange dot fails contrast on dark theme.

harper (Design): Copy idea for the toggle: "Keep short spikes" (under smoothing). Keep legend compact: series name on first line, micro-state on second line collapsed behind a chevron by default. micro-state content: "smooth:on  preserve:local_peak  thresh=auto" but hide it on narrow widths.

raj (PM): For thresholds, percent vs absolute matters (e.g., 3 sigma on latency vs % error). suggest an "adaptive (auto)" setting and an overrides field. also surface a tiny "peak" badge in the legend when a preserved spike exists in last 5m.

noa (VizEng): Implementation constraints: current legend is single-line and overflows quickly. proposal: compact two-line legend per series, with overflow menu for config; mobile stacks as two lines. performance: marker count must be capped (preserve N most recent peaks) to avoid DOM bloat.

toni (A11y): Keyboard shortcut request: allow toggling smoothing for the focused chart with Shift+P, show tooltip "Shift+P: toggle preserve spikes". ensure focus ring is 3px and meets WCAG for both light/dark. aria-describedby on series toggle should read smoothing state and preserve-mode.

ux-bot: New mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/mockups/preserve-peaks-v2.png

harper (Design): I'll update the component spec (incl. copy, microcopy for legend badge, and responsive behavior) and open a PR with QA checklist: keyboard nav, color contrast, legend truncation, adaptive threshold cases, and stress test for marker capping.

raj (PM): Plan: A/B test current smoothing vs local_peak_preserve on staging for 2 weeks across infra/edge metrics. measure incident detection recall and false positives.

noa (VizEng): Dev notes: add metric-type hint to chart config (rate|latency|count) so preservation heuristics can tune themselves. also keep a debug toggle to show raw-preserved indices for QA.

toni (A11y): I'll add an accessibility test to the QA list (screen reader readouts for preserved peaks, keyboard shortcut discoverability, colorblind pattern visibility).
